title: Universal Capability Interface — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Gives software a common way to discover tools, inspect requirements, and invoke compatible capabilities. A proposed common interface through which software discovers what tools can do, inspects their requirements, and invokes compatible capabilities — one contract for every tool instead of a thousand bespoke integrations. The paste flags the related Universal Capability Graph (#96) as one of the five most powerful tools to build first; this interface is how software would actually call what the graph maps.
